Later note-main advances were treated as write/concurrency state only and did not change semantic control or source selection.

boundary.candidate_identity_rule: source-qualified/run-stable identity; exact C10 worker source blobs carried on every assessment

audit_provenance_gate.reason: Frozen role config revision 7 requires bootstrap_valid=true plus frozen control provenance for audit corrections. The inspected recent primary audit did not carry bootstrap_valid=true and froze under earlier downstream control/config; CURRENT reproducibility is older and also lacks the current validity field. Their semantic corrections were therefore not imported into C10 scoring. Worker-source evidence and fresh primary-source crosschecks were used instead.

external_primary_crosschecks.note: Primary abstract confirms evaluation-meta-knowledge fine-tuning produces safer benchmark behavior even when explicit evaluation-awareness verbalization is excluded; code/models are linked.
Primary abstract confirms 9.4 pp Python measurement inflation, RAG improvement in 18/32 model-language cells, adversarial increases up to 45 pp, and threat-model-dependent defense ordering.
Primary abstract confirms AUROC about 0.94 can coexist with up to 26 pp intervention harm and reports the 50-task pilot plus ALFWorld +2.8 pp p=0.014 result.
Primary abstract confirms 2,823 episodes, AUROC 0.872, cold-vs-recalibrated transfer 0.527 vs 0.885, and live repair 45% vs 16% with success 52% to 73%.
Primary abstract confirms conditional e-process validity with fresh evaluation randomness under adaptive GAN updates and reports competitive image-benchmark results.
Primary abstract confirms frozen-executor Harness MDP, offline advantage-weighted regression using only terminal task-rubric rewards, and ablations versus BC/Forced CHECK.
Primary abstract confirms Shapley step attribution and boundary-adaptive coalition sampling on SkillsBench, but not the secondary detailed numeric cells.
Primary abstract confirms progress-aware transactional tool semantics across fault/speculation/contention workloads and separates retry/progress from external-effect isolation.

assessments.tested_scope: Public DriftLens commit 0b7b943... exact UC8 wrapper/entrypoint/window/threshold code path.
assessments.rationale: Exact public-code inspection shows the official shell wrapper omits --run_driftlens; its parsed seed and threshold_sensitivity are inert on the inspected path, and the wrapper's radius2 HDF5 names do not line up with the inspected embedding notebook. These are strong reproducibility-path findings.
limits: This is not evidence that the paper's authors used the broken wrapper for every reported result.
Missing public radius2 generation is an artifact-lineage gap, not proof of nonexistence.
No detector-quality effect is inferred from the wrapper defect alone.

assessments.tested_scope: Synthesis of constrained-MDP safe improvement, multi-objective SPIBB, and anytime-valid off-policy confidence-sequence primitives under their separate assumptions.
assessments.rationale: Each primitive has direct primary support, but the proposed automation controller that simultaneously requires a current-baseline utility lower bound plus separate safety/calibration upper bounds with time-uniform evidence is a transfer composition rather than a published matched end-to-end result.
limits: Expected cumulative-cost guarantees are not pathwise hard safety.
Off-policy support/overlap is required.
Adaptive candidate generation needs separate selection-validity control.

assessments.tested_scope: Logged contextual-bandit setting with predictable logging, bounded rewards, fixed finite policy class, and stated variance/overlap conditions.
assessments.rationale: The primary theorem gives time-uniform survivor-set control and gap-dependent stopping; simulations report substantial sample savings when true gaps exceed planning assumptions. This directly supports evidence-driven stopping for a frozen candidate batch.
limits: Does not cover arbitrarily adding data-dependent policies to the same confidence family.
Poor overlap can make candidates unevaluable.
Preprint; no independent replication identified.

assessments.tested_scope: One-sided sign symmetry with a precommitted discordant-count horizon; total task count remains random.
assessments.rationale: The construction has a transparent one-step martingale identity and exact terminal continuation formula; worker-local exact DP reports finite-horizon power/size cells. Evidence is mathematically stronger than heuristic simulation but the new derivation/numerics are not independently published or rerun.
limits: Not terminal-equivalent to fixed-total-task McNemar.
No independent numerical replication in this wave.

assessments.tested_scope: Fixed total-task horizon; reference discordance model used only to choose predictable sign bets while validity relies on conditional sign symmetry.
assessments.rationale: A 600k-rep worker Monte Carlo suggests the projected bet recovers much of prior Bellman finite-horizon power while retaining a simple conditional-e-variable proof under predictable discordance rates.
limits: Power can degrade under reference-model mismatch.
Not terminal-equivalent to fixed-task McNemar.
Numerical results remain same-pipeline computations.

assessments.tested_scope: Outcome-adaptive benchmark/task selection in which future discordance propensity depends predictably on past paired outcomes while each new discordant sign is locally symmetric.
assessments.rationale: The worker's exact control DP gives Type-I maxima above 0.05 for bounded adaptive discordance schedules, exposing a concrete measurement-validity failure mode that is consistent with the distinction between standard fixed-sampling McNemar assumptions and adaptive filtrations.
limits: Does not challenge classical exact McNemar under its standard sampling model.
Counterexample DP is not independently rerun/published.

assessments.tested_scope: Three model families fine-tuned on evaluation-design meta-knowledge and tested on six safety benchmarks; reported Nemotron multi-seed replication plus benign over-refusal control.
assessments.rationale: A direct causal training intervention changes safety-benchmark behavior while the effect persists when explicit evaluation-awareness verbalization is excluded; simultaneous benign over-refusal shows a utility tradeoff rather than a pure safety gain. Code/models are released.
limits: Benchmark behavior is not deployment-continuous safety.
Does not imply all safety post-training gains are evaluation-awareness artifacts.
Independent replication not identified.

assessments.tested_scope: Eight models x four languages, seven inference-time defenses, standard and fabricated-package adversarial prompts.
assessments.rationale: Primary abstract verifies a 9.4 pp Python bookkeeping overestimate, RAG improvement in 18/32 configurations, adversarial PHR increases up to 45 pp, and threat-model-dependent defense ordering. Acceptance record strengthens venue status.
limits: Current worker extraction is abstract/headline-level; per-cell tables are not yet verified.
18/32 reductions does not imply the other 14 all worsened.
No independent replication identified.

assessments.tested_scope: 15-conversation main multi-turn red-team pilot plus documented longer development runs; single-turn-trained attacker used out of distribution.
assessments.rationale: Attacker refusals and long-run objective drift demonstrate that red-team pressure itself can fail, making apparent victim robustness partially evaluator-limited. The main jailbreak declarations are conservative/unanimous, so the evidence is specifically about attacker reliability.
limits: Small pilot and partly development-run evidence.
Does not invalidate reported jailbreaks.
No matched anti-drift intervention isolates effect size.

assessments.tested_scope: Three attacker/defender co-training rounds with fixed external safety benchmarks and separately reported attacker-strength curve.
assessments.rationale: Defender ASR falls over rounds on two fixed benchmarks while the attacker also strengthens against a base defender, showing iterative co-evolution can improve safety in the tested multimodal setup.
limits: Not a separately re-optimized held-out attacker against every frozen defender snapshot under a fixed budget.
Does not establish monotone robustness under arbitrary adaptive attack.

assessments.tested_scope: HotPotQA/GAIA/ALFWorld across multiple base agents using a high-AUROC critic and actual intervention; 50-task pilot estimates disruption/recovery tradeoff.
assessments.rationale: Strong offline prediction does not imply beneficial intervention: outcomes range from substantial harm to modest benefit. The p*r-(1-p)*d decomposition and pilot decision test connect detector accuracy to final task success rather than surrogate AUROC alone.
limits: Specific to tested critic/interventions/benchmarks.
Pilot estimates can be noisy and need deployment matching.
No independent replication identified.

assessments.tested_scope: 2,823 committed episodes across three frameworks/models plus external ranking-transfer corpora; deterministic checks and live rollback/rerun repair.
assessments.rationale: The source reports AUROC 0.872, severe cold-calibration degradation, deterministic-verifier zero-FP controls in tested checks, and live repair 45% vs 16% resampling with p=0.0005, lifting task success 52% to 73%. Code/traces/results are released.
limits: Learned monitor requires deployment recalibration.
Deterministic checks cover only mechanically verifiable invariants.
Author-released artifacts are not independent replication.

assessments.tested_scope: SWE-bench Verified under stated target FPR budgets, same-policy restart with optional diff carry-forward, compared with cold restart.
assessments.rationale: Worker-verified primary headline results show token savings and a resolution gain for RestartSmart while cold restart is near baseline, supporting carry-forward policy as a separate recovery variable.
limits: Current comparator did not apply later primary-audit table corrections because they lack bootstrap_valid=true under the frozen contract.
Richer cut-timing/statistical details remain outside this assessment.

assessments.tested_scope: Checkpoint restore immediately before irreversible actions in a Claude Code/Qwen3-32B MCP testbed.
assessments.rationale: 10/10 duplicate-commit replays versus 0/10 no-checkpoint and 2/2 stateless credential reuse illustrate a concrete semantic rollback hazard that request-ID deduplication alone may miss.
limits: Small proof-of-concept.
Full proposed defense is not implemented/evaluated.
Does not quantify prevalence in general agent deployments.

assessments.tested_scope: Transactional tool-use prototype across fault/speculation/contention workloads; separate recovery-success and irreversible-effect-safety tests.
assessments.rationale: Primary source supports transaction/frontier mechanisms and a strong effect-safety axis, while pure recovery success can be close to checkpoint replay. This is useful evidence that task completion and residual external-effect safety must be scored separately.
limits: Prototype scope is limited and metadata/adapters are trusted.
No claim of distributed/full crash-safe exactly-once.
No valid-bootstrap downstream audit correction was applied in this run.

assessments.tested_scope: Streaming user-revision setting with action classes idempotent/reversible/compensable/irreversible; StreamBench n=1,008 on DeepSeek-V3.
assessments.rationale: Formal treatment separates earliest-conflict rollback from irreversible repair cost, and reported quality matches full restart while discarding 14.6x fewer completed steps.
limits: User-revision setting is adjacent to, not identical with, autonomous failure recovery.
No selector-only checkpoint-target factorial.

assessments.tested_scope: Adaptive GAN training with networks fixed before fresh evaluation randomness; conditional e-values/e-processes under observed-training-sample or population-level freshness assumptions.
assessments.rationale: The theorem directly demonstrates how an adaptively trained object can still be evaluated anytime-validly when frozen before fresh evaluation data. CIFAR-10 five-seed results support viability across objectives.
limits: CIFAR comparison matches generator updates but not total discriminator compute.
Best checkpoint metrics/hyperparameter selection use the same five-seed setup.
Not a proof for QD archive mutation.

assessments.tested_scope: Four uncertain-QD tasks, 10 replications per algorithm/task/sampling-size, 1120 runs; reevaluation charged to the same sampling budget.
assessments.rationale: Archive-Sampling/Parallel-Adaptive-Sampling provide matched-budget evidence that uniform heavy verification can suppress exploration, while small provisional archive depth and delayed/selective reevaluation can improve corrected QD outcomes; D in {1,2,4} is explicitly ablated.
limits: D=2 is empirical for tested tasks, not universal.
Stochastic fitness/descriptors are not identical to LLM-judge false-admit/false-reject noise.

assessments.tested_scope: Physical Review Research model; official code at pinned commit; worker paired 50-realization cells with corrected Eq.15 metric, bootstrap intervals/sign tests and tau/time controls.
assessments.rationale: The new paired analysis strengthens a low-corruption benefit boundary while adjacent higher-corruption cells lose or reverse advantage; official-code provenance and paired realization control make the scoped result reproducible.
limits: Worker rerun is same-pipeline/local, not independent replication.
Seed policy is worker-defined rather than exact paper stochastic replay.
High-corruption mean reversals are not robust.

assessments.tested_scope: Fresh Argus upstream call-site/source audit of stage/route mutators and daemon/Manager lock coverage.
assessments.rationale: The normal resident-daemon mutation path is serialized by the outer Manager pipeline lock, materially narrowing prior race concerns. Low-level mutators still lack authenticated caller capability and exact state-revision CAS, supporting a defense-in-depth authority gap rather than a demonstrated production race.
limits: No current non-daemon production bypass proven.
No exploit or outcome effect demonstrated.
Filesystem-readability/authorization usability must remain separate.

assessments.tested_scope: Six controlled domains plus adapted tau-bench retail/DB-Bench; frozen LLM executor; offline advantage weighting from terminal rubric rewards; public code inspected.
assessments.rationale: Paper/code support harness control as a learnable layer, with AW broader than BC and Forced CHECK while final-quality gains remain selective. Code confirms terminal-rubric training rather than cost-aware optimization and exposes a reconstructable epsilon-mixture behavior law.
limits: Adapter scores are adapted Harness-MDP metrics, not official upstream benchmark scores.
Released trajectories do not log propensities/masks as first-class fields.
Exact BC/Forced-CHECK reproduction entrypoint remains unresolved.

assessments.tested_scope: Released harness epsilon-perturbed collector; proposed extension to a safer Lean meta-action mixture.
assessments.rationale: The exact behavior-law formula is reconstructable from pinned code, motivating direct propensity logging and support-aware OPE design. The Lean randomization matrix itself is a transfer proposal, not an evaluated result.
limits: No Lean-specific matched effect.
Masked/expensive action support must be designed prospectively.
No OPE result is reported by the source paper.

assessments.tested_scope: SAGE public repository/docs plus reported system-level recovery evidence; current wave inspects routing, verdict clamp, output grounding, and promised-but-not-located supplementary traces.
assessments.rationale: Public architecture makes diagnosis-to-repair routing auditable and explicitly separates numeric grounding from unresolved method-provenance verification. This supports the structured-recovery mechanism but not full review-closure credit.
limits: Per-topic recovery traces were not located in the inspected GitHub snapshot.
Do not equate metrics-bearing recovery with fully reconciled scientific closure.
Absence from the repo is not proof the supplementary package is unavailable elsewhere.

assessments.tested_scope: Six cloud-service categories, 9 production Skills, 98 skill-reference files; comparison against self-reflection and single-turn-QA-driven evolution.
assessments.rationale: Primary abstract supports +23.0 and +15.4 point advantages and a distinct governance layer, making richer multi-turn feedback a credible remedy for gradient starvation in the tested four-round evolution setting.
limits: Absolute R1-R4 TSR/bloat/regression cells are secondary extraction pending primary-table verification.
Only four reported evolution rounds; does not close >10-round gating frontier.
Independent replication not identified.

assessments.tested_scope: Skill-step Shapley attribution on SkillsBench with boundary-adaptive coalition sampling.
assessments.rationale: Primary abstract supports efficient identification of high/low-value skill steps; detailed 99-configuration/206-edge and removal-curve numbers remain secondary until full primary verification.
limits: No cross-version/descendant causal lineage result.
Detailed estimator-error and length-neutral controls not yet primary-verified.

assessments.tested_scope: MindSkillEvolve SpreadsheetBench result plus public runner/server code at pinned commit c1befcb... for batchwise skill evolution.
assessments.rationale: Primary abstract reports +9.2 pp over initial-skill baseline, while inspected public code mints/stages schema-valid patches after trajectory summaries without a visible held-out behavioral A/B gate on that generic path. This separates evidence of online skill improvement from evidence of statistically gated promotion.
limits: Public code path may differ from the exact paper experiment or unpublished deployment wrappers.
No claim that all MindMemOS evolution components lack validation.
No independent benchmark replication identified.

high_strength: Failure/meta-evaluation evidence now includes a direct causal evaluation-meta-knowledge intervention with multi-seed support and an over-refusal tradeoff.

Long-horizon evidence strongly separates detector quality, intervention disruption/recovery, carry-forward policy, and irreversible-effect settlement; live repair and transactional-effect studies support distinct axes.
Uncertain-QD supplies a matched-budget positive control for reversible provisional archives and selective reevaluation instead of uniform heavy verification.
Astrocyte-gated associative memory gains are now narrowed by paired official-code local reruns to a reproducible low-corruption phase boundary rather than a broad advantage.

Adaptive-evaluation work supplies exact filtration hazards: fixed-class anytime policy elimination and locally derived paired-test counterexamples both argue for frozen candidates/rules before fresh evidence.
major_holds: No C10 audit correction was imported because inspected audit artifacts lacked bootstrap_valid=true under the frozen role-config contract.
The three new evaluation constructions are worker-local derivations/numerics; no independent rerun upgrades them beyond B+.
FE-059 package-hallucination claims remain headline/abstract-level until full per-cell tables/artifacts are verified.
SAGE public architecture is auditable, but per-topic recovery/reconciliation traces were not located in the inspected public repository snapshot.
SkillEvo absolute four-round TSR/bloat cells and SkillShapley detailed configuration/edge counts remain secondary extractions pending primary tables.
Argus current normal daemon path is lock-serialized; the remaining case is primitive-bound authority/stale-state defense-in-depth, not a demonstrated production race.

exact_next_action: Integrator should consume this evidence only with novelty and decision-relevance outputs carrying the identical C10 wave_id, ACTIVE_WAVE blob and source_set_digest and only if their bootstrap_valid guards are true. Next evidence work should prioritize a valid-bootstrap source-matched audit pass for C10, primary full-table verification for FE-059/SkillEvo/SkillShapley, independent reruns of the evaluation DP and astrocyte phase boundary, and a strict selector-only historical-restore factorial.
